name: s81bf_front_static_clk-c3-COMMIT
purpose: BF clock-structure pass 2026-10-15 (S-ELEM-PQ, gate ec84ce526 FAILED CTS: hold repair ~119k buffers, util 102.8%; io_clk 202-252 ps vs ck 259-307 ps, boundary->core -158.9 ps because the io_clk programme flop fanned straight into the core issue cone). ck and io_clk stay two related roots of ONE die clock (same_pll_fixed_phase; one root measured 329 ps > 300 at 16,824 sinks, gate 75030). Every io_clk->ck crossing is now register -> lockup latch (io_clk low) -> register with no fan-out: programme pin flop -> latch -> programme_core_q (ck) -> issue (+1 edge, producer DELTA -1, issue edges vs go unchanged); cfg/go/go_bf/xs_v/xb_v through latches like the payload (0 cycles). f_rd replicated 17x (one kept copy per 32-bit read slice, was 4,378 loads); CPIN seam reset relay 1 -> 5 per face (<=160 loads). Outline/pins unchanged; no relaxed timing. | c3 (route c2 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD 26k buffers, measured): (1) kit SDC: the multi-entry die-skew reserve (hold 100/setup 150-210) was applied to EVERY ot_entry pair incl. the 12,276 same-root core paths -> now only between different entries (tools/ref_tile/clock_entry_constraints.py; FF hold violators 27,050 -> 3,401 on the c2 placement); (2) every free-clock core register under one always-enabled ICG u_fcg (same gating depth as the gated core; was 236.8 vs 329.1 ps hi0q_r->b_hi); programme register moved into the core on that clock; (3) core->seam crossing through one shared lockup-latch bank on the core root (ck low).
